nbee1e09279.headline: Benchaâboun: The budget deficit should reach 7.5% of GDP
nbee1e09279.summary: Morocco's official reserve assets increased by 39 billion dirhams since December 2019, covering more than seven months of imports, while the budget deficit is projected at 7.5% of GDP.
nbee1e09279.why: Budget deficits and foreign reserves are key indicators of fiscal health and economic stability in Morocco.

n1a5d8ed06c.headline: Azerbaijani oil prices fall
n1a5d8ed06c.summary: The price of Azeri Light crude oil produced at the Azeri-Chirag-Deepwater Gunashli field declined by $1.07 to $44.67 per barrel on July 22.
n1a5d8ed06c.why: Azeri Light is a key regional crude benchmark; price changes affect Azerbaijan's oil revenues and broader regional energy markets.
n1a5d8ed06c.why_moved: The decline in Azeri Light crude price reflects global oil market fluctuations impacting Azerbaijan's energy sector.
